entry.name: maximum
entry.description: Watches an input stream for any numbers which are greater than its most recently set maximum. If the input value is less than or equal to the maximum, the maximum value is output. If the input value is greater, that value is output.

arguments.name: initial
arguments.description: Sets an initial value to be compared with numbers received in the left inlet. If the argument contains a decimal point, all numbers are compared as floats, and the output is a float. If there is no argument, the initial value is 0.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Sends the most recent output out the outlet again.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Converted to, unless there is a float argument, in which case all numbers are compared as floats.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: Converted to, unless there is a float argument, in which case all numbers are compared as floats.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored for comparison with subsequent numbers received in the left inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: If the number is greater than the value currently stored in, it is sent out the outlet. Otherwise, the stored value is sent out.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Compare all values and output maximum
messages.description: In left inlet: The numbers in the list are all compared to each other, and the greatest value is sent out the outlet. The value stored inis replaced by the next greatest value in the list.Theobject accepts lists of up to 256 elements.
